meta.name: sunpump-meme-token-toolkit
meta.description: Create meme tokens on SunPump (`sun sunpump launch`), trade them — both pre-launch (bonding curve via `sun sunpump buy/sell`) and post-launch (SunSwap via `sun swap`) — and query token info, rankings, holders, portfolios, and trade history.

copy.tagline: 在 SunPump 上创建和交易 meme 代币
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 SunPump 上发行或交易 meme 代币
copy.tagline_en: Create and trade meme tokens on SunPump
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to launch or trade meme tokens on SunPump

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能在TRON区块链的SunPump上创建meme代币，交易它们（预启动阶段用买入/卖出，启动后通过SunSwap），并查询代币信息、排名、持仓、交易历史和持有者。
howto.when: 当你要求创建meme代币、交易代币（买入或卖出）、查询持仓或代币信息、查看排名或交易历史时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个叫DOGE的meme代币，供应量10亿
看看代币ABC123的24小时交易量排名

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to create meme tokens on SunPump (TRON), trade them (pre-launch via bonding curve buy/sell, post-launch via SunSwap), and query token info, rankings, portfolios, holders, and trade history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a meme token, trade tokens (buy/sell), check portfolio or token info, view rankings, or list trade history.

say_en.text: Create a meme token called DOGE with 1 billion supply

say_en.note: Claude calls sun sunpump token ranking --type VOLUME_24H --size 10
